title: Search request
description: One query across the searchable corpus (issue #180): textbook blocks, drill questions and memos. 'mode' picks the backend leg(s): 'keyword' (deterministic Postgres tsvector 'simple' + pg_trgm, no LLM in the path, reproducible and explainable), 'semantic' (pgvector similarity over an embedded query), or 'hybrid' (both legs fused by RRF). Absent 'mode' means 'hybrid' -- a harness protocol default, not a pack tuning value (ADR-0002 governs pack content, not this). 'resources' filters by resource label (ADR-0018); the harness holds no closed enum of resources. Drill expected answers and holdout drills (sys:holdout) are never part of the searchable corpus at any mode -- see contracts/schemas/search/README.md. The request carries no learner identity: the server scopes every query to the authenticated user (from auth, never the body), returning only shared corpus rows and rows that user owns.

mode.description: Backend leg(s) to use. Defaults to 'hybrid' when absent.

resources.description: Resource labels to search (ADR-0018), e.g. 'textbook_block'. Empty or absent means every searchable resource.
